entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello, David... I'm calling about an order. I... I think I might need to make a return, and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-92B. It's for the new helmet I bought. It just... wasn't what I hoped for.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered nine days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the helmet?

It's the color. On the website, it looked like a vibrant red, but in person, it's more of a dull orange. With gear that's so important for safety, I just don't feel confident wearing it if I don't love it, you know? The box is still unopened; I haven't even taken it out.
I understand completely. When it comes to safety equipment, you have to be 100% satisfied. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. I was just hoping this would be easy. I really needed this money back for some unexpected expenses.
Thanks for your patience. I've checked our system, and I have good news. Since your item was delivered only nine days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not at all. I am processing that return for you right now. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. All you need to do is print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Wow, that's perfect. Thank you so much, David. You've been a huge help today.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
